black-and-gold-giant.alt: The black-and-gold giant stands over the night city with light gathering in its chest and its curved blades spread.
A giant black and gold Ender walks between the towers of a burning city at night.
Chang'e's parents hurry her away down a burning street while the black and gold giant towers behind them.

changes-mother.alt: Chang'e's mother, a woman with short pink hair and glasses, smiles in a lab coat beside a framed family photo.

courtyard.alt: Two cadets in dark uniforms cross the Academy courtyard below a blue holographic panel on the white main building.

felt-dolls.alt: Two small felt dolls and a photo frame stand on a desk behind a phone that shows the two girls together.

giant-enders.alt: A ship flies over a burning city at sunset while giant golden Enders stand among the towers.
A giant black Ender with glowing orange eyes looms over a burning ruin in a tall comic strip.

lollipop.alt: Selena smirks at the viewer with a round pink lollipop held close to her chin.

platforms.alt: A wide ruined platform under a storm sky, with Vexana and a mass of Enders at one end and Guinevere alone at the other.
On the scorched platform among ruins and smoke, Vexana gets her staff under her and rises to one knee.
Vexana stands alone on a ruined platform under a storm sky, her staff raised, tall gray Enders all around her.

rubys-scythe.alt: Seen from behind, Ruby holds her tall scythe among burning ruins while androids float in the air around her.
Ruby shouts with her scythe raised beside her while Angela stands behind her with light in her hands.

singularity.alt: Four small figures stand with their backs turned before the huge four-pointed purple Singularity over a ruined city.

vexanas-room.alt: Vexana's room, a tidy room with a bare desk and a window that looks out on a neon city at night.
A gloved hand holds a phone showing a photo of Guinevere and Vexana, with a white box, a photo frame and two dolls on the desk.

wings-of-light.alt: Guinevere glows red as her wings of light spread behind her like flames, a cat-faced drone on each side.

base-alarm.alt: A small figure stands at the far end of a long corridor lit red by the alarm.

sea-of-stars.alt: Pale planets and small moons drift across a field of stars, with thin streaks of pink and white light.

visor.alt: Lesley, seen from behind with her long gold hair over her face, lifts a gloved hand to her visor.
An extreme close up of Lesley's face, her blue star-shaped visor over one eye and a red eye beside it.

black-ships.alt: A ship hovers low over a ruined street between broken towers, blue light beneath its hull.
A ship with blue thrusters flies over a burning city at sunset while giant Enders stand among the towers.

fall-of-the-research-base.alt: A giant black and gold Ender walks between the towers of a burning city at night.
Lesley stands in the burning ruins with her rifle while an Ender falls through the air beside her.

first-entrance-assessment.alt: Chang'e, small, in round glasses and a white coat, holds a pen and a board while Lesley stands behind her.

lead-guard.alt: The lead Guard's gold crest glows in the dark above a tall unlit shape, violet star-shaped plates on either side.

northeastern-sector-breach.alt: A gold giant Ender spreads its arms in a ring of light against a sunset sky, a glow at its chest.

selenas-blades.alt: Selena in her armor, with black and gold blades hanging in the air around her, stands before a dark column cut by red light.

street-at-the-domes-foot.alt: In a memory, Vexana in her school uniform holds out a hand on a smoky battlefield.

team-b3-drill.alt: A shining blue cable wraps the arm of a clawed Ender and holds it back.
A white streak of cannon fire passes Fanny and bursts an Ender in a cloud of pink light.

trojan.alt: A red warning square with an android's outline and the word DANGER glows on a dark screen.

academy-feed.alt: Selena starts back from the phone she holds sideways, her mouth open and papers flying around her desk.

small-black-spheres.alt: Obsidia holds out a clawed hand, a small black sphere ringed with fire floating on each side of her.

third-year-lounge.alt: Layla sits alone on a sofa in the sunset, one finger holding down a slat of the window blinds.
